statusText: Watch: Tail 23% with the 30,409.25 overnight low holding a second hour against a record-yield, high-oil backdrop.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail at 23% sits inside the watch band and below the block threshold. The narrow evidence-based danger window runs 13:30Z to 15:00Z, covering the US cash open and the 14:00Z JOLTS and CB Consumer Confidence releases.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures hold the 30,409.25 overnight low for a second hour while Asia trades lower; Tail eases to 23% with Stress at 79%
body: The 05:00Z clock-hour is the second in which the Nasdaq-100 futures low has not extended. NQ December reads 30,429.00 at 05:17:26Z on Yahoo Finance, -137.25 and -0.45% against a 30,566.25 previous close, with a Globex range of 30,409.25 to 30,616.00; Investing.com shows 30,421.75 on a delayed 00:48Z print with the same 30,409.25 low. Price therefore sits roughly 20 points above the overnight low and near the bottom of a 207-point band, drifting rather than extending. The 28 September cash session is the more informative structural evidence: the Nasdaq-100 index closed at 30,276.81, -1.08%, having traded a low of 30,081.06, so a retracement of roughly 195 points developed into the close. That is a mean-reverting close, not a failed-retracement path. Against that sits a genuinely aligned cross-asset stack. The 10-year Treasury yield rose six basis points to 5.24%, its highest since 2007, and the 30-year reached 5.56%, the highest since 2004, with positioning shifting toward further Fed tightening. WTI trades near $94.38 and Brent near $107.37, both up about 2%, after the rejection of Iran's seven-day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Semiconductors led Monday's decline, with ARM -8.7%, QCOM -7.2%, INTC -5.7% and AMD -3.6% against NVDA +1.7%, and megacap breadth was one positive in eight. Asia has extended the tone, the Nikkei down 1.2% and the KOSPI down 0.6%. The offsetting evidence is that VIX closed at 16.07, up 8.1% but low in absolute terms, and that no repeated extension after a failed retracement has been observed overnight. Tail therefore eases one point to 23% and remains inside the watch band; the aligned amplifiers are real but they are expressed in a difficult environment rather than in a pathological price path, which is where Stress at 79% carries the weight. Shared Finviz context was read at the start of the run and was 4.2 hours old with collectionStatus partial and its futures section unavailable, so it was treated as stale and used for discovery only.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours run from the European morning of 28 September to the hour before this assessment, and every slot has a published Claude assessment. The window opened at 21% Tail with Stress at 79% and stayed inside the 20-27% range throughout. Two hours reached the elevated band and neither persisted: 09:00Z at 26% during the European long-end repricing, and 14:00Z at 27% around the US cash open and the early afternoon. Both were back in the watch band within one hour. Tail fell to 17-19% across the late US session and the first overnight hours as the cash market closed having retraced roughly 195 points off its low, then firmed again to 24% at 01:00Z, 03:00Z and 04:00Z as the Asian session extended the downside drift. Stress rose steadily from 79% to a peak of 85% during Monday's European and US sessions before easing back to 76-79% overnight. Confidence improved from 81% to 88% as the session produced observable evidence and has held there.
outlookSummary: The conditional path opens at 23% for the current 05:00Z hour, where the twice-held 30,409.25 low and a 1.2% Nikkei decline are the observed evidence on either side of the judgment. It eases to 22% across the Tokyo close, firms to 23-24% through the European cash and Bund open, and marks 09:00Z at the top of the watch band because that is the recurring long-end window that reached 26% on Monday. The single elevated stretch is 14:00Z to 15:00Z at 26% and 25%, covering the JOLTS and CB Consumer Confidence releases landing 30 minutes into the cash session in a market already repricing toward Fed tightening; the mapped policy state is BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES for those two hours only. That elevation is scheduled rather than observed, and Monday's precedent is that such prints were followed by a return to the watch band within one hour. The path then normalises to 22-23% through the Fed speaker block and the quarter-end close, reaches its low of 19% in the 22:00Z gap between the US close and the Asian open, and holds 20-21% across Asia into a 30 September session carrying ADP, Core PCE and final Q2 GDP. Confidence decays from 88% to 80% with horizon.

forecast.analysis: Observed: NQ December reads 30,429.00 at 05:17Z, -137.25 and -0.45%, with the 30,409.25 Globex low unextended for a second consecutive hour. Asia is broadly lower, the Nikkei off 1.2%. The drift is directional but orderly, so Tail eases one point to 23% while the aligned cross-asset stack holds Stress at 79%.
